Description
AccountTokenRowMapper
Maps a row of the account_tokens table to an AccountToken.
AuthorizationJacksonModuleContributor
Extension point that adds a Jackson module to the mapper of the stored authorizations (AuthorizationJsonMapperFactory), for a feature whose authentication or attribute types the framework's security modules do not cover (for example the passkeys, whose module Spring Security leaves out of SecurityJacksonModules).
AuthorizationJsonMapperFactory
Creates the JSON mapper that serializes the attributes and token claims stored with each authorization.
DevDataInitializer
Seeds a demo user and a confidential BFF client when the dev profile is active, so a freshly started authorization server has someone to sign in and a client to sign in through.
